experiments.scope: The blake3-r2-prefix-v1 target. Each trial executes the search of proof.md 9.1, 9.8 and 9.9 for one context (priced instance: flags 3, counter t by step CT): seven outer words and eight members from the seed; per member its walk over the first 2^10 steps in blocks, the level-16 test, the live blocks' class list words with the packed Y9 fill, prefilter and word test; per passing lane the pre-check, joint screen and joint solver, and for a certified root both last-chunk compressions and the 256-bit test. In-run checks: those of proof.md 9.2, among them every eighth trial a planted true instance in its class list and one word cut by its member's class mask, tested with the aliveness test of Lemma CP (alive fails the run). The returned pair is built by steps CO and CT on the harness instance (counter 0, flags 11, t_hi = 0) for the trial's context and first passing member.
experiments.hypothesis: For every trial the two complete 2-round digests (counter 0, flags 11) agree on digest words 0, 2, 5 and 7, the 128 masked bits: after the first half of round 2 the two states differ only in Y3 and Y11, and the only differing message word of the diagonal step is w5; none enters diagonals 0 and 2. The 16 observations are the program's own counts, untrusted (blocks, live, words, e_lanes, passes, prechecked, solver_calls, roots, units, checks, mismatches, halted and others). Expected per trial (outcome set S, proof.md 9.10; 256 preregistered seeds): about 8.2 blocks, 0.59 live, 8.2 words, 0.16 passes, 0.04 prechecked, 0.008 solver calls, almost always no root; mismatches and halted 0. The counter instance cannot be digest-checked by the organizer; the run is not evidence of attack cost.
